Case note: O.S. No. 2650/2024
Client: Bhavana Mukherjee (professor, Mysuru)
Opposing party: Mahesh Gowda
Court: Mysuru District Court
Filed on: 08/02/2024
Claim amount: INR 1,35,00,000/-
Issue: land dispute. Relatives dispute who owns the ancestral land.
Advice given: Trace the chain of title through the mutation entries.
Outcome: The title of the client was upheld.
Recommended next step: Apply for correction of the land records.
